answer: Admission occurs through a ceremony where every identity consumes one unique ember-keyed ticket. Each participant must verify their orchard of past credentials against a nullifier list to expose duplicates. An honest agent pays 1.0 unit, while a sybil farm faces a relic of costs for 1,000 fakes. A verifier rejects any signal lacking a nullifier; if evidence of duplication appears, the stake is burned. This assumes non-collusion.
